2) Identify invoice date:
- The header shows "Rechnung 24006347 vom 29.01.2024". Clear invoice date = "29.01.2024".

3) Identify Grand Total:
- The text near totals: "* Rechnungsbetrag 2.088,00 EUR *". Interpreted as total payable amount = 2.088,00 EUR → numeric 2088.00 (preserve decimals as two places).

  - At bottom in bank/company details: "UID-Nr.: ATU 22684307" — this appears with company/bank and Firmenbuch details for the seller (KAINDL Technischer Industriebedarf). Therefore sender VAT ID = "ATU22684307".

6) Check for multiple VAT groups or ambiguous values:
- Only one VAT rate/group applies to the invoice totals (20%). No other invoice-level exchange rates present. Line items each show "20 %" in the rightmost column, consistent. So single VAT group: Net 1740.00, Vat 348.00, Rate 20.

7) No inference beyond visible text:
- All extracted values correspond to explicit text. Where alternatives existed (which UID corresponds to sender), I selected the UID appearing with the seller/company info at the bottom rather than the recipient block.

8) Decimal and format handling:
- Original amounts use comma thousand/decimal formatting; converted to numeric values preserving two decimal places: 2088.00, 1740.00, 348.00. VAT rate recorded as integer 20.

These are the determinations I will use for the final extraction.
